name: codeflow-local

scripts.prebuild: pnpm --filter @codeflow/config build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/parsers build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/graph build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/retrieval build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/analyzers build
scripts.pretypecheck: pnpm --filter @codeflow/config build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/parsers build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/graph build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/retrieval build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/analyzers build
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @codeflow/config build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/parsers build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/graph build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/retrieval build && pnpm --filter @codeflow/analyzers build && pnpm bundle

description: Analyse a repository entirely on your machine — dependency graph, metrics and grounded search. No API key, no network, no code leaves the device.
